title: ansible-role-for-splunk virtual lab
lede: A fork of `splunk/ansible-role-for-splunk` whose own product is the **virtual lab** under `testing/`: a Docker and Molecule harness that builds a multi-node Splunk estate and deploys it with the role over SSH, from a controller you log into as in production. Specs, decisions and design live in the repo on `feature/virtual-lab`; answers saved here are copied into their decision files.
